lens: Geometry and proportion first, then colour, materials and artefacts. Candidate renders S/rH (q15-q18) and studio shots S/sH; baseline S/r0 (8b1ab84, same econ code, lighting L9). git diff 8b1ab84..1430d42 -- src/09a_econ.js is empty; 09_seats.js changes touch only the pyShell, pyArm and pyArmPad SEATMAT rows, so econ geometry and materials are byte-identical to the w51 state (f1ab8cc). Every shift between r0 and rH comes from lighting ('cool PY/Y seat level', L14). Median colours were measured with numpy in fixed boxes on r0, rH and the paired ANA photo, resized to 930x575. q18 bezel extents came from row and column dark profiles. Work dir: S/raterB (t18.jpg = r0 / rH / y_47305 stack; studio.jpg = e1, e3, e4, e7, e6, e9 montage).

prior.status: none in econ geometry or materials
prior.note: The only change is a lighting-driven cool cast (see issue L-final-1).

issues.what: Carried w51b-1: the 3-seat-block headrest flap is short and high. Its foot sits ~40 px above y_47303's, and the blob is wider than it is tall (97 x 78 against 79 x 100).
issues.evidence: The geometry is identical to w51 (empty 09a_econ.js diff). cmp_q17_econBacks.jpg shows the same outline in r0 and rH.
issues.fix: Gated on question 32: give the drape blocks a longer CPL (prepend [0.615,-0.150], [0.628,-0.151]) with the hem, foot tube, stitch and mark moved to the new foot. As A proposes, also bring the rolls in to sx ±0.128 so the flap overlaps them.

issues.what: Carried: the centre cover top is ~5 px low and slightly squat. The pillows are a little larger, flatter and more rectangular than y_47300's soft dog-eared cushions.
issues.evidence: Pillow box medians are rH (36,44,84) sd 8 against photo (43,50,85) sd 14, so the render's pillow has about half the photo's texture variation and less weave.
issues.fix: Raise the 4-seat fold ~1 cm (w51b-2). Add a faint weave layer to the pillow material.

issues.what: The near seat-back side fabric (left edge) shows a blotchy, smeared fleck at close range, against the photo's fine weave (the photo is defocused there, so this matters little).
issues.evidence: t18.jpg, x 140-300: large soft blobs with no fine structure.
issues.fix: A triplanar blend or mip bias on the side faces (lighting/tex, as from_econ.md asks), or per-face UVs on the back side panel.

issues.what: Carried lows: the J armrest elbow sits ~50 px forward and the bar is thin; the pocket pouch is flat; strap tone; flat pillow plaque; dark edge under the pan front.
issues.evidence: e6, e7 and e1 are unchanged.
issues.fix: As in w49b-3, w49b-4, w48b-3 and w41b-*.

issues.what: L-final-1: the 'cool PY/Y seat level' (L14) adds a blue cast to every econ surface. The fabrics are now noticeably bluer than the photos, and even the white armrests turn bluish.
issues.fix: Halve the blue gain of the PY/Y seat-level cool term in the econ zone, or apply it as luminance only. Target q17 armrest B-R <= 6 and q15 back B/R <= 2.0. Optionally add +5 % on R and G for the pan and back level (the photo pans are ~15 L lighter).

issues.what: Carried w43b-L1: the headrest covers read navy-violet from off-axis angles, where the photos show a silver-grey leatherette sheen (y_47301, y_47303). This is the largest remaining thumbnail-level mismatch.
issues.evidence: q17 flap median (131,138,175). In y_47301 and y_47303 the off-axis covers are light grey, ~L110-150 and neutral.
issues.fix: A cover-only grazing sheen lobe (Fresnel-weighted, neutral grey) in the shader for the econ cover material, as asked in from_econ.md.

issues.what: The near right-block backs are too dark and the far rows a little light and snowy compared with y_47301 (the camera also doesn't frame the photo exactly).
issues.evidence: Near right back rH (30,40,88) against photo (56,75,143). Far left (55,67,118) against (49,59,112).
issues.fix: Right-side fill on the near aisle seats. Fade the photo-tile contrast and the mip bias with distance.

notes: Final confirm: the econ code is byte-identical to the w51 state, so there are no geometry or material regressions. All r0 -> rH differences come from lighting run 4 L14. Proportions still hold: the q15 head-on covers match y_47300 in width and height, the screen bezel in q18 is ~1.6:1 like the photo's 1.55-1.63 with a matching ~8 % white shroud margin, and the arms, belts, pans and legs are unchanged. The single medium econ item is the q17 3-seat flap length (question 32). The overall score is 8.6, essentially my w51 8.65. The 0.05 reflects that the new cool cast takes the visible fabric hue further from the photos (B/R 2.1-2.2 vs 1.8-1.9). That cast is a lighting issue, but it changes how the econ colour reads. High-severity econ issues: 0.
